annotate_figure_grid_layout — ANNOTATE paper op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import annotate; annotate.annotate_figure_grid_layout(shapes, ncols=2, pad=10, caption_h=32, title_h=0, letter_style='paren') (or opsannotate.get("annotate_figure_grid_layout"))

Usage

Returns a table (dict): the typesetting of a multi-panel figure (cell, panel and caption-band rectangles) in closed form.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

:func:panel_grid と同じ式: `cw/ch` は最大パネル寸、

`W = 2*pad + ncols*cw + (ncols-1)*pad`、

`H = title_h + 2*pad + nrows*(ch+caption_h) + (nrows-1)*pad`。

パネルは拡大せずセルの中央に置く。

Returns

-------

dict

``{"size":(H,W), "cells":[(x,y,cw,ch)], "panels":[(x,y,w,h)],

"captions":[(x,y,cw,caption_h)], "letters":[str], "ncols", "nrows"}``。

Raises

------

ValueError

shapes が空、ncols < 1、負の余白、26 枚を超える。
